summary: T1 (PT-PT default) largely PASSED — fresh localStorage on preview host yields html lang='pt', PT nav (Estimador, Calculadoras, Preços, Blogue, Descobrir), PT footer tokens (Estime/Compare/Construa, Investidores, Menções legais), no FR leaks; MarketToggle FR click persists in localStorage across reload and PT click restores. Backend regression: 18/18 pytest passing (test_c2_wave.py — admin PT/FR login, /me lang/country, /compute PT default, catalog PT, all SPA routes PT/FR/EN). GET /hero-pt.mp4 → 200 video/mp4 content-length=2138786. GET / → <html lang="pt-PT">. T2 (hero video) has TWO defects: (a) Route '/' does NOT delegate to LandingPortugal for PT users — App.js line 146 always renders <Landing/>, so a PT default user never sees the pt-hero-video on '/'. Video only exists on '/portugal'. (b) Even on /portugal, the <video> renders but does NOT autoplay: DOM shows autoplay='' but muted attribute is null and video.paused=true, currentTime=0, box height collapses to 150px, area appears black/empty. This is React's known caveat: JSX `muted` boolean prop is not reliably reflected as HTML attribute, so browser blocks unmuted autoplay.

ui_bugs.issue: Video does not autoplay — muted attribute not applied to DOM (React JSX `muted` prop caveat). Result: video.paused=true, currentTime=0, black frame visible. Fix: use `muted={true}` combined with a ref that sets videoRef.current.muted=true and .play() on mount, OR use dangerouslySetInnerHTML/plain <video muted>. Also add poster attribute to avoid blank frame while loading, and give the container a fixed aspect-ratio (currently collapses to 150px height).

Route path="/" always renders <Landing/> regardless of detected lang. Spec says PT default user visiting / should automatically render <LandingPortugal/>. Fix: wrap root route with a small selector that returns <LandingPortugal/> when lang==='pt' (or add a redirect to /portugal for pt users). Currently pt-hero-video is unreachable from /.

issues: Video container has max-h-[520px] but no min-height / aspect-ratio → collapses to ~150px until metadata loads; renders black empty rectangle. Add aspectRatio 16/9 or a poster image.

action_items: Fix <video> autoplay on LandingPortugal.jsx: replace JSX `muted` with ref-based imperative muted+play, or use static <video muted autoPlay loop playsInline preload="auto" poster="...">. Consider adding a poster (e.g. demo-plans-poster.jpg) so the hero is not blank while the mp4 loads.
Fix container: give <video> wrapper a defined aspect-ratio (e.g. aspect-video) so it does not collapse to 150px height.
Route '/' to LandingPortugal when detected lang==='pt' (or redirect /→/portugal for pt users) so new PT visitors actually see the pt-hero-video as specified in the T2 acceptance.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html served with <html lang="pt-PT"> as required.
hero-pt.mp4 file present at 2,138,786 bytes and served with content-type video/mp4 through the CDN.

Root route wiring does not match the T2 spec ("visitar / — cai automaticamente em LandingPortugal"). Either the spec must be relaxed to /portugal or App.js must be updated to render LandingPortugal for lang==='pt'.
React <video muted> attribute serialization pitfall — always set muted imperatively via ref for reliable autoplay across Chromium/Safari.

rca_of_the_issue: React JSX renders boolean HTML attribute `muted` inconsistently; when `<video muted autoPlay>` is rendered, some Chromium builds see no `muted` attribute in DOM → treat as unmuted → block autoplay per user-gesture policy. Confirmed here by DOM inspection (getAttribute('muted') === null while getAttribute('autoplay') === ''). Combined with the root-route not delegating to LandingPortugal, new PT users cannot see the demo video from /.
